title: Airport Travel
description: Practice asking for help at the airport and handling common travel situations.
descriptionZh: 练习在机场询问信息和处理常见旅行场景。

context.setting: An airport service desk where the learner needs help with travel questions.
context.learnerPurpose: Ask clear questions about flights, boarding, luggage, and delays.

goals.label: Handle a luggage question
successCriteria: Asks for the next step politely

constraints: Keep the interaction practical and helpful.
Do not create complex emergency situations.
